claim.en: According to Aktuality.sk (2022), Roman Chudý is a lawyer and a former prosecutor.

findings.identity: Lawyer Roman Chudý running in the Trnava region in 2022; the official 2022 TTSK candidate list gives him as a 53-year-old lawyer from Piešťany for ŽIVOT – národná strana, matching the candidate (lawyer, Piešťany, 57 in 2026).
findings.quote: Advokát a bývalý prokurátor Roman Chudý kandiduje za stranu ŽIVOT – národná strana.
